sourceRecording.creator: Brian M. Jones, solo piano transcription and performance, September 2010
sourceRecording.sourceHistory: Commons records a YouTube-derived Ogg from Brian M. Jones solo piano transcription; use the exact catalog original, not the separate NC four-hand performance.
sourceRecording.evidenceSummary: The specific Commons page separately labels the Brian M. Jones performance CC BY 3.0 and identifies its September 2010 solo transcription/YouTube source. Original downloaded bytes match the source SHA-1. This is not the distinct NC-licensed Romero/White four-hand performance.

pianoSamples.evidenceSummary: The YDP Grand Piano section on FreePats identifies Zenph/OLPC sources and the CC BY 3.0 grant. The downloaded 2016-08-04 soundfont includes matching original credits and license declaration.
